Definition: to be (causatively, make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively, to provoke)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be contentious, be rebellious, be refractory, be disobedient towards, be rebellious against; 1a) (Qal) to be disobedient, be rebellious; 1a1) towards father; 1a2) towards God; 1b) (Hiphil) to show rebelliousness, show disobedience, disobey
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
